calculation.description: For each tradable asset, compute lagged 40-session log return, subtract its lagged 60-session beta to the equal-weight cross-asset daily return multiplied by lagged 40-session benchmark return, divide by lagged 40-session return volatility, and smooth over five sessions. The empirically predictive direction is inverse (portfolio consumers should multiply the raw signal by -1).
calculation.lookahead_control: All rolling statistics and signals are shifted so only completed sessions through t-1 are used.

validation.regime_notes: Negative raw direction is stable over the full sample and 750/1260-session windows; the recent 365-session window reversed sign, so direction and drift require monitoring. Small cross-asset universe is explicitly retained; dates have at least 8 valid instruments, but average coverage is 80.07% due to beta warm-up and missing observations.
validation.provenance: Computed by miner_2 validation script; library correlation awaits deterministic downstream audit.
